notes.title: PGA TOUR 2K25 | Season 2 Trailer
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=5m-j_bN_n74;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]SEASON 2 IS HERE! [/h2]
With it comes a whole new mode—Challenges—a new Clubhouse Pass, a new 18-hole course, and a whole host of fresh gear to earn as you play.

[h2]THE OLD COURSE AT ST. ANDREWS[/h2]
There are a lot of things to be excited about, but golf fans young and old will be absolutely chuffed to hear that the Old Course at St. Andrews Links is making its official PGA TOUR 2K debut in Season 2! 
The Old Course at St. Andrews is the oldest and most iconic golf course in the world, dating back to the 15th century. Many consider it the birthplace of golf, and over the years its features have been given suitably epic names, such as those bunkers with names like “The Coffins,” and “The Seven Sisters”. The Old Course is available to play now for all players.

[h2]CLUBHOUSE PASS[/h2]
Season 2 re-ups the rewards with a whole new set of upgrades, enhancements, and gear for you to earn as you play with this Season’s Clubhouse Pass. This season’s free reward tiers include a Cobra White Snapback, Malbon Shorts, a Ruby Titleist T100 Iron, and a whole lot more!
Play to reach the Free Tier 25 and earn a new free shot type—The Long Flop! As with a standard Flop Shot, this shot is performed with a wedge and features a high trajectory, plenty of spin, and a short run. However, this shot is designed to carry farther—perfect for when you need to flop but need just a little extra reach to achieve greatness

[h2]EQUIPMENT PROGRESSION[/h2]
During each season, players can evolve their equipment to a specific tier cap. The top tier target for Season 2 is Amethyst, though players can also now upgrade to Ruby as a key milestone. Get on the course and start swinging to earn equipment XP—there will be in-game challenges related to upgrading your equipment!

[h2]FEATURED ARCHETYPE - THE GREENSKEEPER[/h2]
There’s nothing “green” about golfers who master Season 2’s featured Archetype, The Greenskeeper. This golfer is a specialist with putter-in-hand. While time spent on the greens means less time spent reading lies and shaping shots, there’s no need to worry—the targeted precision of a Greenkeeper’s short game more than makes up for the occasional unpredictability of less-skillful approach shots.
Go green in Season 2! Create a MyPLAYER with the Greenskeeper Archetype to complete specific seasonal quests tailored to this playstyle for Season 2. Experiment with the unmatched putting skills of this Archetype while still having the freedom to return to your original build whenever you choose. Whether you're fine-tuning your short game or just exploring a new way to play, this season is the perfect time to grow your game.

[h2]NEW! PLAYERS CARDS[/h2]
This season, make your mark with a Player Card that’s as distinctive as you are! Enjoy enhanced customization options featuring unique designs that showcase your style both on and off the course. 
While Season 2 brings with it a whole new set of Clubhouse Pass (CHP) rewards to earn, players can still work on obtaining Season 1 CHP Rewards at any time.

[i]Requires PGA TOUR 2K25, internet connection and 2K account. 
Clubhouse Pass rewards require unlocking with gameplay. Clubhouse Pass Premium is available for separate purchase. Paid Premium Passes unlock additional rewards for the Season through gameplay. For more information on Clubhouse Pass, and Premium Pass offerings, go to pgatour.2k.com/2k25/clubhouse/ [/i]

notes.title: PGA TOUR 2K25 Developer Diaries | MyPLAYER | 2K
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=QKs4pCdpEZA;full][/previewyoutube]
Whether looking to become the ultimate PGA TOUR Pro in [url=https://pgatour.2k.com/2k25/up-your-game/mycareer/]MyCAREER [/url]or rise through the ranks in multiplayer, get started with the most customizable MyPLAYER experience yet.

To give you the ability to create your ideal digital golfer, base head models have been quadrupled, exponentially increasing customization options. In addition, a larger variety of skin tones has been added, the number and style of different hair options—including facial hair—has increased, and you can now customize your body type, including shape, muscle definition, and height.

PGA TOUR 2K25 has also added additional changes to MyPLAYER that are more than skin deep. As before, you will choose an archetype with a set of starting attributes for each MyPLAYER you create. However, in PGA TOUR 2K25, this archetype is permanent! That’s because the new attribute progression system—along with Tools and Fittings—gives you the opportunity to build on your MyPLAYER’s attributes and really lean into a specific playstyle.

[h3][u][b]Archetypes[/b][/u][/h3]
Choosing the archetype that best suits your playstyle is the key to having a great foundation on which to build your perfect golfer.

In PGA TOUR 2K25, you can choose from the following archetypes:
[list][*] [b]Powerhouse:[/b] The Powerhouse’s primary focus is hitting the long ball consistently, even when challenged with a poor lie. However, a Powerhouse must be wary of their ability to keep the ball on target both on and off the green.
[*] [b]Technician:[/b] A Technician takes advantage of consistent contact with their swing path. Finding fairways and greens with regularity, the Technician golfer will hardly notice the lack of the long ball.
[*] [b]Magician:[/b] A primary focus for the Magician is a focus on recovery shots paired with a more vertical default swing path and solid power. Getting out of tricky lies shouldn’t be a problem for the Magician.
[*] [b]Greenskeeper: [/b]What the Greenskeeper lacks off the green is made up for with a putter in hand. They can be relatively consistent playing off the tee and fairway, but the deeper the grass the deeper the struggle.
[*] [b]Sculptor:[/b] The Sculptor is an artist with any club in hand. No one can shape shots through the air like the Sculptor. A relatively balanced golfer, the Sculptor’s skill doesn’t translate to rolling the ball on the green.[/list] Can’t decide on a particular archetype? You don’t have to! In PGA TOUR 2K25, you can have multiple MyPLAYERs all suited to a different style of play. Experiment with different archetypes and progression paths and never feel locked into your first pick!

[h3][u][b]Attributes[/b][/u][/h3]
Attributes define your MyPLAYER’s ability to swing and putt. Each archetype has its own set of starting attributes that are reflective of the specific playstyle. To improve these attributes, play to earn VC. Then you can use VC to apply Attribute Points.

As you level up and assign Attribute points to your MyPLAYER, your Overall Rating (OVR) will increase. Your OVR is a measure of your total attribute ceiling. By default, each MyPLAYER has enough attribute points unlocked to progress to OVR 85. Earn XP through completing rounds and objectives to increase your MyPLAYER level. Each MyPLAYER level rewards more Attribute Points that can then be used to achieve the 99 OVR cap.

[h3][u][b]Rebirth[/b][/u][/h3]
Once you reach an OVR of 90 with one MyPLAYER, you unlock ‘Rebirth’. This gives any new MyPLAYERs a pool of free Attribute Points that you can assign right away—giving you a well-earned jump start on your new MyPLAYER’s progress.

[h3][u][b]Skill Trees[/b][/u][/h3]
Skills in PGA TOUR 2K25 have been completely overhauled with new branching trees for each discipline on the course! Each tree is populated with a ton of all new shot types and the ability to improve your proficiency for each type.

There are a limited number of Skill Points available. How you choose to spend your Skill Points will be key, much like with Attribute Points, to creating the ideal golfer for you. Though keep in mind that you can always Start another MyPLAYER or reset your skill tree if you want to try a different playstyle.

There are 5 main skill trees to choose from:
[list] [*] Tee
[*] Approach
[*] Recovery
[*] Bunker
[*] Green [/list] To learn more about these types of different shots, read up on [url=https://pgatour.2k.com/2k25/up-your-game/how-to-swing/]Mastering Your Swing.[/url]

[h3][u][b]Equipment Progression[/b][/u][/h3]
PGA TOUR 2K25 introduces Equipment Progression—the ability to earn experience on the clubs and balls that you choose to take into each round.

To learn all about Equipment Progression, read up on[url=https://pgatour.2k.com/2k25/up-your-game/tokens-tools-fittings/] LVL↑ Tokens, Fittings, and the Evo-Tool. [/url]

notes.title: PGA TOUR 2K25 Developer Diaries | MyCAREER | 2K
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=QKs4pCdpEZA;full][/previewyoutube]
In MyCAREER, choose to start your journey in Q-School, on the Korn Ferry Tour, or by jumping directly into the PGA TOUR. Compete for points in tournaments that mirror the real-life PGA TOUR schedule. Your goal is to finish in the Top 70 and earn your spot in the playoffs for a chance to compete for the coveted FedExCup.

Let’s jump into some of the key additions this year.

[h3][u][b]Make History in Major Championships[/b][/u][/h3]
We’re really excited to include three Major Championships in PGA TOUR 2K25—the PGA Championship, the U.S. Open, and The Open Championship—along with their 2025 courses—Quail Hollow Club, Oakmont Country Club, and Royal Portrush Golf Club, respectively.

[h3][u][b]Dynamic Rounds[/b][/u][/h3]
Full rounds of golf can sometimes take a bit of time. We recognize that life sometimes gets in the way of doing what you really want to do—play PGA TOUR 2K25—so this year we have added the option to shorten the time commitment of MyCAREER rounds by using your MyPLAYER’s current skill level to dynamically simulate holes on a course.There are two options in which to play MyCAREER rounds in a shorter timeframe:

[list][*][b]Dynamic Rounds:[/b] A section of the course is chosen for play so players can get through rounds as quickly as possible.
[list][*]Choose the number of holes to play—with separate options for regular events, alternate events, signature events, major events, and the FedEx-Cup Playoffs.
[*]Choose which holes to play: opening holes, closing holes, or "dynamic," which picks a different section of the course to play every round
[*]Choose whether the unplayed holes are simulated based on skill, or set to even par for the entire field (essentially skipping the hole for everyone).[/list]
[*] [b]Interactive Simulation:[/b] Players can jump in and out of a round at any point to choose exactly what holes they would like to play. Players must play at least 4 holes for these simulated rounds to count[/list]

You’ll find these Dynamic Round and Sim options in MyCAREER, then use R1/L1 (Playstation), RB/L1 (Xbox), or E/Q (PC) to select the Settings menu. Once here, use R2/L2 (Playstation), RT/LT (Xbox), or Z/X (PC) to select the round settings you’d like to change.

[h3][u][b]Training Scenarios[/b][/u][/h3]
In PGA TOUR 2K25, you can participate in bite-sized training scenarios to boost your MyPLAYER attributes for that week’s tournament. These scenarios test your skill with the club, by tasking you to complete challenges such as landing on the green within a certain amount of shots or sinking a few long putts. Before tournament rounds, you can also compete in Practice Rounds. This is your chance to get the lay of the land before your reputation is on the line.

[h3][u][b]Sponsorship Events[/b][/u][/h3]
Grow your relationship with Sponsors through photoshoots and media campaigns. Participating in these events will earn you Sponsor Rep. The higher your Sponsor Rep, the more Tier Points you will earn through play. Tier Points are the key to earning cool rewards from your sponsor, such as apparel, equipment, consumables, or VC.

[h3][u][b]Personality and Popularity[/b][/u][/h3]
A new Conversation and Interview System lets you experience building a fan base as you develop your own MyPLAYER personality.After a MyCAREER tournament is finished, players will receive:

[list]
[*]     Invites to press conferences and sit-down interviews with media outlets
[*]     Messages from fellow PGA TOUR pros to compete in Rivalries
[*]     Messages from major brands for sponsorship opportunities
[/list]

[b]Conversations[/b]
In every Conversation, the user can build out their MyPLAYER’s personality, which can be bold, reserved, or composed. We encourage you to pick the Personality that resonates with you; then stay consistent in the public eye to increase your Popularity quickly.

[b]Sponsorships[/b]
Performance based sponsorship opportunities will arise that result in a change to the player’s popularity. Reaching each threshold of popularity will earn the user a chunk of VC to improve their MyPLAYER’s attributes, equipment, or apparel.

[h3][u][b]Dilemmas[/b][/u][/h3]
During MyCAREER, you will be presented with various Dilemmas that can make a direct impact on the course. Do you choose to hit the weights hard and gain some power, or focus on mobility to improve your rhythm?Each decision will have a meaningful impact on your MyPLAYER’s attributes in the next tournament.

[h3][u][b]Quests[/b][/u][/h3]
A new Quest system adds more depth to your MyCAREER journey—and the rest of PGA TOUR 2K25. This new system gives added challenges that can be completed to earn different rewards on a daily, weekly, or seasonal basis. To see Quests, in the Main Menu, MyCAREER or MyPLAYER sections, press Options (Playstation), Menu (Xbox), or M (PC) to bring up the Profile Menu. Then select Quests.

During MyCAREER, the main Quest is the GOAT Checklist inspired by the career of our legendary cover athlete, Tiger Woods. To finish this checklist, you will need to win tournaments, complete the career grand slam, earn fans, defeat your rivals, and build your brand by signing sponsorships.

Thank you for reading and watching! Want to see more Developer Diaries? Click here to learn more about PGA TOUR 2K25's [url=https://pgatour.2k.com/2k25/up-your-game/myplayer/]MyPLAYER[/url] mode!
